description: This file defines the Socks5ProxyHandler class, which manages SOCKS5 proxy requests, including initial handshake, authentication, and command processing, within a Netty-based server.

classes.name: Socks5ProxyHandler
classes.description: A Netty channel handler that manages SOCKS5 proxy protocol, including authentication and command handling.

methods.name: Socks5ProxyHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with configuration, logger, and server lifecycle objects.

methods.name: channelRead0
methods.description: Processes incoming SOCKS5 messages and delegates to specific handlers based on message type.

methods.name: handleInitialRequest
methods.description: Handles the SOCKS5 initial request, determining authentication method.

methods.name: answerInitialRequest
methods.description: Sends response to initial request, setting up the next decoder in the pipeline.

methods.name: handlePasswordAuthRequest
methods.description: Handles password authentication requests, validating credentials.

methods.name: handleCommandRequest
methods.description: Processes SOCKS5 command requests, primarily handling CONNECT commands.
